tasks.description: Enforce rate limits using a token-bucket algorithm scoped to each API key. This will ensure that each key gets an independent allowance. The algorithm should be designed to handle a high volume of requests.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid API key, when the token-bucket algorithm is applied, then the request is allowed or blocked based on the available tokens.

tasks.description: Make the bucket capacity and refill rate configurable via application configuration, without requiring code changes to adjust them. This will allow for easy modification of the rate limits as needed.
acceptance_criteria: Given a configuration file, when the bucket capacity and refill rate are updated, then the new values are reflected in the token-bucket algorithm.

tasks.description: Store rate-limit counters/state in Redis so limits are enforced consistently across all server instances. This will ensure that the rate limits are applied uniformly across all instances.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Redis instance, when a request is made, then the rate-limit counter is updated in Redis.

tasks.description: When a key exceeds its limit, reject the request with an HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) status. This will inform the client that they have exceeded their rate limit.
acceptance_criteria: Given an API key that has exceeded its rate limit, when a request is made, then a 429 response is returned.

tasks.description: Include a `Retry-After` header on 429 responses indicating how long the client should wait before retrying. This will help the client to understand when they can make another request.
acceptance_criteria: Given a 429 response, when the Retry-After header is checked, then it contains the correct time to wait before retrying.

tasks.description: The middleware should sit in front of the API routes and apply uniformly to authenticated API traffic keyed by API key. This will ensure that the rate limits are applied to all API requests.
acceptance_criteria: Given an API request, when the middleware is applied, then the rate limit is checked and enforced.

tasks.description: Write unit tests to ensure that the rate-limiting middleware is working correctly. This will help to catch any bugs or issues with the implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a set of test cases, when the unit tests are run, then all tests pass.
